incoming_learnings: Guard pulls can displace a requested escape and leave crippled movement consuming two turns. Revalidate the actual landing and transit exposure before committing to another doorway setup; a geometric endpoint alone is not a safe escape.

review.review: The hero remained alive at full health. Decision 1121's accepted move exposed a piranha pool and uncollected chest; decision 1122 then exhausted the planner because retrieval preparation declined while descent remained forbidden. Offline reconstruction matched all 1,122 preceding actions and reasons. The carried ivory potion was unidentified, with no carried identification resource. The entrance is not an eligible unknown-potion test bank, and its eight-move chest approach already exceeds the existing conservative invisibility round-trip budget. Complete source inspection resolves the selecting-state gap but does not establish a safe replacement. No policy patch or new regression is supplied: guessing the potion, stepping inside the fish buffer, or merely increasing the route bound would not resolve these safety blockers. Existing relevant tests passed, but no candidate red/green or full candidate-suite result is claimed.
review.learnings: A mandatory pool chest needs an executable preparation and retrieval plan, not just an expected floor potion. Preserve unknown identities, fish buffers, verified pickup requirements, and explicit planner exhaustion. Establish a funded alternative before changing this admission.

recommendations.summary: Establish executable preparation and retrieval when the pool entrance cannot fund the protected chest round trip.

recommendations.reason: Revalidated here, but no safe focused patch is established. Terminal probes find no eligible fresh pool-test bank or admitted protected journey. No carried nonconsumptive identification resource remains, and the nearest safe entrance requires at least eight moves each way: 21 turns under existing accounting versus a nominal 20-turn invisibility effect. A larger route bound alone is insufficient. Next derive this doorway and habitat fixture and validate a bounded ranged-clearance alternative with public charge/damage funding, safe firing and retreat positions, fresh defeat receipts, and verified chest pickup, or establish an identification-plus-retrieval transaction. Do not guess ivory, relax habitat checks, waive mandatory pickup, or restore death-waits.
